arguments:
set -Eeuo pipefail
work=$(mktemp -d /tmp/rea-leads-group-verify.XXXXXX)
trap 'rm -rf "$work"' EXIT
git -c credential.helper= clone -q --depth 1 --branch fix/dual-account-groups-bootstrap-20261031 https://github.com/martaxi-boss/telegram-robot-leads.git "$work/repo"
cd "$work/repo"
echo TESTED_BRANCH $(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD)
echo TESTED_SHA $(git rev-parse HEAD)
git -c credential.helper= fetch -q --depth 20 origin main:refs/remotes/origin/main
git diff --check origin/main HEAD
test -s docs/BOOTSTRAP.md
test -s tests/test_group_membership_per_account.py
sudo -n /opt/telegram-robot-leads/.venv/bin/python -B -m unittest discover -s tests -q
echo GITHUB_SAVED_GROUP_BOOTSTRAP_TESTS_PASS
